scope.value: platform-neutral deterministic lifecycle and idempotent scheduler/task receipt contract for V20 G4 and G8

evidence: V20 Kanban tasks table and current task graph
V20 Kanban task_runs table and current run rows
V20 Kanban task_events table and current event rows
V20 Kanban task_links table and current dependency graph
V20 Kanban tasks/task_runs schema and current claims

entry_guard.value: immutable workflow_id; originating Brennan instruction or admitted V20 contract reference; authority classification

exit_guard.value: scope, owner, dependencies, evidence location, acceptance criteria, stop condition; exact approval reference for denied authority before runnable
frozen testable contract binds scope, inputs, clocks, metrics, acceptance criteria, stop conditions, evidence
implementation evidence and verification satisfy frozen contract

entry_guard.value: authoritative IMPLEMENT receipt outcome VERIFIED and explicit research-only training authorization in contract

exit_guard.value: frozen input, code/environment identity, execution bounds, output evidence

entry_guard.value: authoritative TRAIN receipt outcome VERIFIED, or sealed contract explicitly specifies no-training evaluation

exit_guard.value: contract-bound inputs, costs, outputs, integrity checks
independent verdict with exact reviewed evidence

entry_guard.value: authoritative REVIEW receipt has recorded verdict

exit_guard.value: STOP, CLOSE, REQUEST_NEW_ADMISSION, or HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; no automatic execution

transition_rules.value: Only immediate forward transitions are permitted; stages cannot be skipped.
Forward transition atomically appends predecessor authoritative exit receipt, persists successor READY, and binds successor to receipt_id; inability to do so yields AMBIGUOUS and no dispatch.
ACTIVE requires entry guard and exclusive durable lease.
Missing receipt, evidence reference, authority reference, or valid predecessor outcome fails closed.

workflow_id.value: assigned once at ADMISSION; never reused, renamed, or reassigned

attempt_id.value: assigned once per execution claim; retry uses new ID with retry_of_attempt_id

receipt_id.value: assigned once per immutable append-only receipt

idempotency_key.value: same workflow_id, stage, and key returns existing attempt/receipt and creates no duplicate runnable attempt

invariant.value: at most one unexpired ACTIVE lease per role_id

expiry_rule.value: expiry records INTERRUPTED and requires reconciliation; it is neither proof of failure nor authorization to retry

outcomes.name: REJECTED
outcomes.meaning: ADMISSION declined before downstream stage runnable

outcomes.name: BLOCKED
outcomes.meaning: named missing dependency or human decision

outcomes.name: INCONCLUSIVE
outcomes.meaning: REVIEW evidence does not justify positive or negative conclusion

outcomes.name: INTERRUPTED
outcomes.meaning: lease/process/dispatcher ended before verified exit receipt

outcomes.name: AMBIGUOUS
outcomes.meaning: durable or external effect cannot be proven

separation.value: distinct reconciler reads immutable inputs, effects, and prior receipts

ready_rule.value: all required predecessors have authoritative VERIFIED receipts meeting their exit guards

block_rule.value: any predecessor REJECTED, FAILED, BLOCKED, INTERRUPTED, AMBIGUOUS, or INCONCLUSIVE blocks dependents with exact blocked_by_receipt_ids and propagated outcome

observed_evidence: current V20 Kanban task_links and parent-driven promotions

current_gate.value: Brennan review; no implementation or authority action is authorized by this proposed contract
